name: Collaborative Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as collabfund.com (collaborativefund.com redirects there), the investor founded by Craig Shapiro whose sixth flagship fund ($125M) TechCrunch reported on 2024-06-10; its site lists Reddit, Olipop, Sweetgreen, Kickstarter, Whoop and Phaidra. Not Collab Holdings, Collaborative Capital or other 'Collaborative' firms.

open_items: Only two rounds recorded. Phaidra amount is 'exceeding $50 million' (recorded as $50M); source is an aggregator-style news site, Ropes & Gray's announcement returned HTTP 403. Phaidra date is the announcement date; page says Seattle-based.
Loyal: Pulse 2.0 does not name a lead (search summaries say Valor and Collaborative led); date 2025-02-26 is the announcement date from search results, the Pulse page is dated 2025-02-28.
HQ not recorded: no fetched page states a location (lead says NYC; TechCrunch has no location). Check size, application URL and cold-inbound status not stated; collabfund.com has no pitch link.

Earlier funds in leads ($33M 2014, $65M 2015, $100M 2018) appear only in search summaries; Tier B records the latest fund only. Periodic Labs and General Intuition are featured on the site but no round page was found. A 2026 Collab Holdings $250M vehicle is mentioned only by a low-authority blog and not recorded.
